messages:
jordan: Heads up — PR #10456 is ready from my side but CI is flaking on one integration test. We should avoid landing during the APAC deploy freeze tomorrow 23:00-02:00 UTC. Any preferred rebase/merge window? @nina @kevin :eyes:
nina: Thanks for the ping. There's a pre-freeze merge window at 02:30 UTC which is after the freeze. If you can hold until then that's safest. Otherwise we need explicit lead approval for emergency merge.
kevin: If CI continues to fail we can request a forced merge with eng-leads approval, but let's try reruns first. @ops-bot can you queue a rerun for PR #10456? :thumbsup:
ops-bot: ci-bot queued build #4872 for PR #10456. Estimated time ~12m.
jordan: Appreciate it. Also, can someone confirm canary is off for this rollout? Don't want partial rollout during freeze window.
alex: I can check canary. Prefer keeping it off until we confirm metrics after roll. I'll leave it off unless @kevin says otherwise.
kevin: I'll give final +1 once CI is green. monitoring it.
ci-bot: Build #4872 completed: 1 failing test: tests/integration/session_timeout_test (likely flaky). Scheduling isolated re-run of affected test.
ops-bot: Isolated re-run scheduled for tests/integration/session_timeout_test.
jordan: That test is flaky historically — we can mark it flaky and land this bugfix since PR has 2 reviews. If we do an exclusion, we need a follow-up ticket to revert/unflake.
nina: Eng leads discussed — approved emergency exclusion only if it's a single flaky test and reviews are complete. Please file a tracking ticket and add reviewers to the exclusion change.
jordan: Filed INF-3421 to track the temporary exclusion + revert. Holding for the re-run result, will request merge in the pre-freeze slot if green. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
